en.intro: Arjuna is frozen between action and collapse. Krishna now describes the inner vision of the wise person who still moves through the world.
en.notice: The knower of reality thinks, 'I do nothing at all,' while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, sleeping, and breathing. The body is active, but the knower claims no doership for it.
en.next: Krishna adds that the senses move among their objects, even while the wise person is speaking, eating, or sleeping.
en.meaning: The knower of reality should think, "I do nothing at all," while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, taking, speaking, discarding, sleeping, breathing, and opening and closing the eyes.

hi.intro: अर्जुन कर्म और पतन के बीच ठिठके हुए हैं। कृष्ण अब उस ज्ञानी की आंतरिक दृष्टि का वर्णन करते हैं जो दुनिया में रहते हुए भी शांत रहता है।
hi.meaning: तत्त्वको जाननेवाला युक्त पुरुष यह समझता है कि मैं कुछ भी नहीं करता, जबकि वह देखता, सुनता, छूता, सूँघता, खाता, चलता, सोता और साँस लेता रहता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण आगे कहते हैं कि ज्ञानी जानता है कि इन्द्रियाँ अपने विषयों में विचरती रहती हैं, चाहे वह बोल रहा हो, खा रहा हो या आँखें मूँद रहा हो।

en.intro: Arjuna is frozen between action and collapse. Krishna now describes the inner vision of the wise person who still moves through the world.
en.body: The knower of reality should think, "I do nothing at all," while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, taking, speaking, discarding, sleeping, breathing, and opening and closing the eyes. The knower of reality thinks, 'I do nothing at all,' while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, sleeping, and breathing. The body is active, but the knower claims no doership for it. Krishna adds that the senses move among their objects, even while the wise person is speaking, eating, or sleeping.
